Job Title

Sales Manager - Parcel

Job Description

Reports to: Parcel Sales Group Leader

Location: UK Remote/Birmingham – with some travel

Contract Type: Permanent

Introduction to role

Vanderlande is the global market leader in sorting systems for parcel and postal solutions and baggage handling systems for airports. The company is also a leading supplier of warehouse automation. Vanderlande has an excellent reputation for reliable project and service delivery, innovation, market awareness and a strong customer focus. We are dedicated to improving our customers’ business processes and competitive position.

Role Responsibilities

The Parcel Sales Manager will work within the UK Parcel Solutions Team, who play a key role in growing our existing accounts as well as generating new business. This role will make an important contribution to our sales success. Your focus is to build and develop strong relationships with our customers and work to ensure that solutions and proposals are developed to meet the customer needs and offer the best value-add solution and service.

Your responsibilities and activities will include:

  • Develop and grow relationships with key parcel customers in the UK
  • Lead and manage matrixed teams during the tender process for sales opportunities (project and service).
  • Lead and manage multi-disciplined teams to support scope definition, design and programme look ahead and to determine the right solution to meet the customer needs and offer the best value-add.
  • Work closely with the UK Contracts Manager in negotiating terms and conditions for project opportunities.
  • Lead presentations of solutions to the customer, including pricing, products and systems layout and how the proposed system or service will operate to meet their commercial requirements.
  • Create effective working relationships with all departments both in the UK and globally (as required e.g. NEME, India) to ensure that customer expectations are exceeded.

Role Qualification and Skills

  • Previous experience automation, in an Engineering or Manufacturing environment
  • Preferred knowledge of the UK parcel market and/or customer operations
  • Strong data analysis and problem-solving skills
  • The ability to interpret drawings is essential
  • Flexibility to undertake European travel as and when required
  • Experience using Microsoft Excel, Power Point and Word

What we offer

  • 28 days annual leave (excluding public holidays)
  • Bupa Medical Cover
  • YuLife – Wellbeing membership with fast access to GP appointments, promotion of health and wellbeing along with daily quests to gain Yucoins that can be swapped for shopping vouchers

  • Yellow Nest is a salary exchange scheme that reduces childcare costs for parents and employers
  • Pension with Aviva

Diversity & Inclusion

raw.excerpt: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations.
raw.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



ポジションについて

CrowdStrike は、世界で最も高度な攻撃者から組織を保護することにより、グローバルセキュリティに変化をもたらすことに専念する、意欲的で自発的なサイバーセキュリティアナリストを探しています。当社の CrowdStrike 仮想セキュリティオペレーションセンターは、さまざまな経験を通じてスキルセットを拡張し、お客様のために発生したインシデントをリアルタイムで検出して対応する機会を提供します。

チームについて

Falcon Complete Teamで成功する人はどんな人？

  • インシデントの検出、封じ込め、修復において、実践的な技術スキルを確かめることに興味がありますか?
  • 意欲的ですか？スキルを急速に向上させる機会を探していますか?
  • 顧客にとって意味のある、革新的な仕事をしたいですか？
  • インシデントレスポンスまたは情報セキュリティの経験を十分に活かせていないと感じていますか。
  • チームをリードし、顧客と関係を構築することに自信はありますか？
  • お互いに刺激し、切磋琢磨できる仲間と仕事がしたいですか？

業務内容

  • Windows、Mac、および Linux プラットフォーム全体でインシデント対応を行う
  • 基本的なマルウェア解析を行う
  • インシデントの検出と対策の実行のためのプロセスを開発および改善する
  • 質の高い書面および口頭でのコミュニケーションを用い、推奨事項、調査結果を顧客管理層に提供する
  • ブログ投稿、クラウドキャスト、およびその他のイベントでの発表等を通じて、業界のソートリーダーシップを示す
  • 内部プログラムまたはチームを管理する

求めるスキル

  • 監督なしで技術的なタスクを完了することができる
  • 技術およびソフトスキルの両者のスキルアップに対する情熱
  • 強いプロジェクト管理スキル
  • インシデントレスポンス業界におけるリーダーとしての貢献
  • 前向きな職場環境と態度を育む能力
  • 技術レベルの異なる聴衆に対し、難解な技術的コンセプトを伝えることが出来るコミュニケーション能力。
  • インシデント対応: 組織のインシデント対応を実施または管理し、持続的標的型攻撃、組織犯罪、ハクティビストなどの標的型脅威を調査した経験
  • コンピュータフォレンジック分析: インシデント対応調査でさまざまなフォレンジック分析ツールを使用して侵害の程度と範囲を特定する知識
  • システム管理: 対策と修復を行うために必要なシステム知識、ツールへの理解
  • ネットワークフォレンジック分析: ネットワークプロトコル、ネットワーク分析ツールに関する知識、および関連するネットワークログの分析力
  • マルウェア解析:静的および動的なマルウェア分析を実行して、マルウェアの性質を理解する機能
  • インシデント管理: 標的型攻撃に関する深い理解と、侵害された組織に合わせた戦術的および戦略的修復計画を作成する能力
  • ネットワークオペレーションおよびアーキテクチャ/エンジニアリング: 安全なネットワークアーキテクチャに関する深い理解と、ネットワークオペレーションの実行に関する豊富な経験
  • プログラミング/スクリプト: C、C#、VB、Python、Perl、Ruby on Rails、および .NET でのコーディング経験
  • 現地の顧客と直接コミュニケーションをとるために必要な高いビジネスレベルから母国語レベルの日本語スキル (ライティングを含む)。言語の校正サポートを必要とせずにドキュメントを作成できるレベル
  • ビジネスレベルの英語力

About the Role:

CrowdStrike is looking for highly motivated, self-driven, Cyber Security analysts dedicated to making a difference in global security by protecting organizations against the most advanced attackers in the world. Our CrowdStrike virtual security operations center offers opportunities to expand your skill set through a wide variety of experiences, detecting and responding to incidents as they occur in real-time for our customers.

About the Team:

What makes you a successful Falcon Complete Team Candidate?

  • Do you find yourself interested in putting your hands-on technical skills to the test in detecting, containing, and remediating incidents?

  • Are you self-motivated and looking for an opportunity to rapidly accelerate your skills?

  • Do you crave new and innovative work that actually matters to your customer?

  • Do you have an Incident Response or Information Security background that you’re not fully utilizing?

  • Are you capable of leading teams and interacting well with customers?

  • Do you love working around like-minded, smart people who you can learn from and mentor on a daily basis?

  • Willing and able to work your allocated shift as part of our global, follow the sun team?

  • The allocated shifts span either Wednesday to Saturday or Sunday to Wednesday for a 40-hour work week. These are slightly longer work days compared to a standard 5-day work week shift.

What You'll Do:

  • Exercise incident handling processes across Windows, Mac, and Linux platforms.

  • Perform basic malware analysis.

  • Develop and improve processes for incident detection and the execution of countermeasures

  • Produce high-quality written and verbal communications, recommendations, and findings to customer management.

  • Demonstrate industry thought leadership through blog posts, CrowdCasts, and other public speaking events.

  • Manage internal programs or teams.

What You’ll Need:

  • Capable of completing technical tasks without supervision.

  • Desire to grow and expand both technical and soft skills.

  • Strong project management skills.

  • Contributing thought leader within the incident response industry.

  • Ability to foster a positive work environment and attitude.

  • Strong verbal and communication skills of difficult technical concepts to audiences with varying levels of technical ability.

  • Incident Handling: experience conducting or managing incident response for organizations, investigating　targeted threats such as the Advanced Persistent Threat, Organized Crime, and Hacktivists.

  • Computer Forensic Analysis: a background using a variety of forensic analysis tools in incident response investigations to determine the extent and scope of compromise.

  • Systems Administration: an understanding of system internals is required to understand how to implement and execute countermeasures and remediation.

  • Network Forensic Analysis: knowledge of network protocols, network analysis tools, and ability to perform analysis of associated network logs.

  • Malware Analysis: ability to perform static and dynamic malware analysis to understand the nature of malware

  • Incident Remediation: strong understanding of targeted attacks and able to create customized tactical and strategic remediation plans for compromised organizations.

  • Network Operations and Architecture/Engineering: strong understanding of secure network architecture and strong background in performing network operations.

  • Programming/Scripting: experience coding in C, C#, VB, Python, Perl, Ruby on Rails, and .NET.

  • High business level to native Japanese language skills (i.e. fluent including writing) required to communicate directly with local customers at a level that does not need peer proofreading.

  • Business level English skills are also required.

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.


Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards
  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs
  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge
  • Paid parental and adoption leaves
  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role
  • Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections
  • Vibrant office culture with world class amenities
  • Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where everyone is valued for who they are and empowered to succeed. We support veterans and individuals with disabilities through our affirmative action program.

CrowdStrike is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants for employment. The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, creed, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy or pregnancy-related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or family status, veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, membership or activity in a local human rights commission, status with regard to public assistance, or any other characteristic protected by law. This is a remote position.

We believe talented professionals shouldn’t be stuck trading time for a salary. The future belongs to people who can turn their expertise into ownership, income, and impact.

At Founder Studio, we help experienced professionals build real businesses by developing strong offers, generating consistent leads, and closing clients.

But there’s a gap most programmes don’t solve: Execution.

That’s where this role comes in.

The Opportunity

This is not just another remote role. You’ll be working directly with:

  • Senior tech professionals (Product Managers, Cybersecurity Experts, Consultants)
  • Founders and operators building real businesses
  • A fast-growing company led by an award-winning, 7-figure founder

You’ll be at the centre of helping people go from “I know what to do” to “I’m actually getting clients.”

In the process, you’ll develop skills that are directly transferable to:

•Running your own agency

•Building a consulting business

  • Operating at a high level in growth or revenue roles

What You’ll Gain

•Fully remote work environment

  • Direct exposure to real client acquisition systems (offers, leads, sales)
  • Experience working with high-level professionals and founders
  • Hands-on ownership of lead generation and pipeline systems
  • A front-row seat to how businesses are built and scaled

This role is ideal for someone who eventually wants to build their own agency, consultancy, or coaching business.

The Role

Your core responsibility: Ensure clients consistently generate leads and conversations.

You will step in after the offer is defined and own execution across:

•LinkedIn outbound and messaging

•Content consistency

•Workshop and pipeline execution

  • Weekly accountability and follow-through

Lead Sourcing & Outbound

You will also:

  • Identify high-intent opportunities (e.g., companies hiring for SOC 2, ISO 27001, GRC)
  • Extract decision-makers (CTOs, CISOs, hiring managers)
  • Turn these signals into targeted lead lists and outbound campaigns

Client Execution Oversight

You will work directly with clients to ensure:

•Outreach is happening consistently

•Opportunities are being sourced

•Content is being published

•Conversations are being generated

•Pipeline is being built

How You’ll Work

  • Run short, focused execution check-ins with clients

•Track activity and progress weekly

  • Identify where clients are stuck and fix it quickly
  • Create content samples on behalf of clients so they see what good looks like
  • Maintain momentum between group sessions

What You Won’t Be Responsible For

•Offer creation

•High-level strategy

•Sales coaching

These are handled by the founder and leadership team.

Who You Are: Experience

You’ve done one or more of the following:

•LinkedIn outbound campaigns

•Agency or client services work

  • SDR, setter, or appointment-setting roles

•Pipeline management

Traits

You’re likely a strong fit if you:

  • Have personally generated leads in a B2B context
  • Can connect opportunities to outreach strategies
  • Are comfortable using tools and figuring things out independently

•Enjoy execution more than theory

  • Are comfortable holding people accountable

This Role Is Not For

  • Social media managers focused only on content creation
  • Virtual assistants who follow tasks but don’t think critically

•Coaches who prefer advising over doing

Why This Role Matters

Our clients already have the knowledge. What changes their outcomes is:

•Consistent execution

•Better opportunities

•A strong pipeline

Your role is to make sure that happens.

How to Apply

Comcast Business offers a suite of Connectivity, Communications, Networking, Cybersecurity, Wireless, and Managed Solutions to help global organizations of all sizes prepare for what’s next. Comcast Business has been consistently recognized by industry analysts and associations as a leader and innovator, and one of the fastest growing providers of Ethernet services.

Job Summary

The Sr. Network Engineer 4, Design & Architecture, supports the design of custom enterprise network solutions for our Comcast Business customers as well as troubleshooting, installing, implementing and administering network systems, and providing Tier IV Help Desk escalation support. Analyzes capacity issues and develops capacity planning models. Responsible for ensuring planned maintenance and testing activities are executed and for developing guidelines for network configuration and security standards.

Role will be virtually based in Colorado or Illinois with up to 15% annual travel.

Job Description

Core Responsibilities:

  • Serves as a technical lead, providing guidance and mentorship to junior network engineers. This position works under limited supervision.
  • Leads the design and implementation of custom network solutions for existing and potential customers. Follows best-practice industry standards to provide a network design which is functional, scalable and secure.
  • Supports the Solutions Architect group to design, document and implement customer pilots and provide support for customer testing as required while in the pilot phase of the sales process.
  • Provides network engineering support to Sales organization as required.
  • Provides Tier IV escalation support to Help Desk. Troubleshoots, diagnoses and resolves customer network issues. When applicable, recommends changes to remediate any network deficiencies to enhance network performance.
  • Researches, evaluates and provides recommendations for new hardware and software solutions, to stay current with new technology and market trends and future requirements.
  • Position requires participation of a rotating “on call” schedule to provide support for our business and customers.
  • Creates technical presentations as needed, presenting to various audiences (both internal and external) with all levels of technical knowledge.
  • Develops, documents and maintains processes and procedures related to design, implementation, maintenance and operations of various complex customer networks.
  • Follows and enforces documented processes and procedures to meet established compliance requirements.
  • Analyzes customer bandwidth requirements and system interdependencies as required. Develops capacity planning models to meet customer’s future needs.
  • Supports various professional services projects for existing or prospective customers to include, but not limited to Network Discovery & Design, Wireless LAN, and Security audits.
  • Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
  • Regular, consistent and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) as necessary.
  • This position is ineligible for visa sponsorship. To be considered for this role, you must be legally authorized to work in the United States and not require sponsorship for employment now or in the future.
  • Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Preferred Qualifications

  • B.A. or B.S. Degree in a technical field from an accredited college or university or equivalent experience (equivalent combination of education and experience considered).
  • 7+ years of experience in network design, implementation, installation, maintenance and troubleshooting of complex enterprise networks.
  • CCNP, JNCIP, FNCSP(NSE4), CCVP, CCSP Certification or equivalent on-the-job experience considered.
  • Strong working knowledge of various Vendor routers, switches, firewalls (Cisco Firepower and Fortinet FortiGate preferred), SDWAN appliances and wireless devices to include; Cisco, Meraki, Fortinet, Juniper, Aerohive, Mist and Cradlepoint

    • SDWAN technologies (Cisco Catalyst preferred)

    • Tunneling protocols to include; GRE, IPSec, DMVPN, IWAN

    • ACLs, AAA, TACACS+, RADIUS, SNMP, DHCP

  • Understanding of VoIP, SIP and PRI voice technologies
  • Understanding of various network tools to include WhatsUp Gold, SolarWinds Orion, Cisco CCE, Cisco Prime, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, Wireshark or Netscout
  • Understanding of various compliance requirements, to include, but not limited to, PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC a plus.

  • Strong technical documentation skills, to include creating network diagrams, operations and maintenance procedures, and technical presentations.
  • Strong verbal skills, to include technical presentations to all levels of technical expertise.

Remote | Micro-equity or volunteer basis | Early-stage AI/Education Startup

Maxibook is an early-stage AI startup rethinking how scientific knowledge is delivered, organized, and personalized.

We are building an Adaptive Knowledge System powered by dynamic knowledge maps and LLM-driven adaptive content, with an MVP expected by Q1 2026.

Our initial focus is on universities, research institutions, and publicly funded initiatives, with future expansion into the corporate HR sector (onboarding, continuous training, skill-gap reduction).

We are entering the fundraising phase and looking for passionate contributors who want to help us build the foundations of a global platform.

Tasks

AI Visuals Creator (Images & Video for Knowledge)

We are looking for a creative contributor who can produce high-quality visuals using AI tools, helping us translate complex scientific concepts into clear, engaging images and short videos.

At Maxibook, visuals are not decoration: they are part of the learning logic. Images and videos support understanding, reduce cognitive load, and adapt to different learner profiles.

What you’ll do

  • Create AI-generated images, diagrams, and short explanatory videos for scientific and educational contexts
  • Experiment with tools such as Midjourney, DALL·E, Stable Diffusion, Runway, Pika, Sora-like pipelines, or similar
  • Collaborate with founders and AI engineers to align visuals with knowledge maps and adaptive content
  • Translate abstract or technical concepts into visual metaphors and narratives
  • Help define early visual guidelines for “adaptive knowledge visuals”

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys exploring the frontier between AI, design, and education, and wants to shape how knowledge is visually experienced.

Bring your enthusiasm, skills, and curiosity into the project. Every contribution matters — you’ll help lay the bricks of a system that could redefine the future of education.

Requirements

We welcome both experienced professionals and early-career talents — what matters most is your genuine interest in AI, education, and the desire to learn and grow with the project.

  • Genuine interest in AI, education, or digital innovation
  • Willingness to commit a few hours per week (flexible, milestone-based)
  • Desire to learn, experiment, and grow together with the project
  • No need to leave your current job or studies — join us part-time while we bootstrap funding

Benefits

We are early-stage, and contributions are currently on a voluntary and micro-equity basis, depending on role, commitment, and duration.

Once funding is secured, we are committed to recognizing and formalizing the contributions of those who supported Maxibook from the very beginning.

It’s about building something that truly matters.

  • Join an international, visionary project from the ground up
  • Gain the opportunity for micro-equity recognition and potential future integration into the founding core
  • Be part of a team pushing the boundaries of AI in education
  • Enjoy visibility, learning, and the excitement of shaping a startup before its official launch

Simply put: we’re working hard to secure funding — in the meantime, we’re building together. Your contribution today could become your long-term place in Maxibook tomorrow.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Maxibook OÜ welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or marital status. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. All personal data shared will be processed with confidentiality and in compliance with privacy standards.

If you are looking for more than a side project — if you want to leave a mark in how the world learns and outreach science — this is your moment.

Apply now to join Maxibook as a contributor. Let’s build together.

About Rimini Street, Inc.

Rimini Street, Inc. (Nasdaq: RMNI), a Russell 2000® Company, is a proven, trusted global provider of end-to-end, mission-critical enterprise software support, managed services and innovative Agentic AI ERP solutions, and is the leading third-party support provider for Oracle, SAP and VMware software.

Our comprehensive portfolio of unified solutions help run, manage, support, customize, configure, connect, protect, monitor, and optimize enterprise application, database and technology software, enabling our clients to achieve better business outcomes, significantly reduce costs and reallocate resources towards strategic projects.

The Company has signed thousands of contracts with Fortune Global 100, Fortune 500, midmarket, public sector and government organizations who selected Rimini Street as their trusted, proven mission-critical enterprise software solutions provider and achieved better operational outcomes, realized billions of US dollars in savings and funded AI and other innovation investments.

We are actively seeking a Sr. Software Licensing Analyst, Oracle. The role will report directly to the Sr. Director, Global License Advisory Services. The Sr. Software Licensing Analyst, Oracle will be based in Mexico and may work from a remote office.

Position Summary

Rimini Street’s Global License and Advisory Services (“GLAS”) organization serves as trusted advisors and subject matter experts on enterprise software licensing. The role of Senior Software Licensing Analyst-Oracle is to provide exceptional remote-based domain expertise on Oracle licensing related inquiries. This position will engage with Rimini Street clients and prospects as well as various departments within Rimini Street. The position will solicit information from prospective clients and current clients regarding their deployment of software programs, license entitlements, and/or support policy inquiries. Based on the type of inquiry, this role will provide direct consultative advice, advisory services for software asset management, and/or general advisory assistance. This position will create requisite collateral, working with additional Rimini Street team members, as needed, including sales, legal, and marketing.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Engage with clients and/or prospects to identify and assess Oracle license or support policy concerns.
  • Provide detailed guidance regarding Oracle audit processes and address client audit/compliance concerns.
  • Articulate possible Oracle licensing or vendor support options and considerations.
  • Analyze and report on Oracle license usage and provide asset management guidance using industry leading software asset management solutions.
  • Build rapport with Rimini Street client-facing teams and become the trusted advisor on Oracle license or support policy questions.

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



About the Role:

CrowdStrike's Data Science team mis seeking a Sr. Manager to lead a team of data scientists at the intersection of Machine Learning, Large Language Models, and Cybersecurity/reverse engineering. This is a leadership role where you will help the team manager business demand/needs, translate them to technical objectives, gain stakeholder buy in, and help drive the technical approaches and provide technical feedback and guidance to junior and experienced team members.

As a technical leader you will support you team in identifying high-value problems in the short, mid, and long term, obtain stakeholder buy in, and translate problems in the business into actionable research objectives. You'll collaborate and work with all aspects of ML and cybersecurity, across a large enterprise and complex data problems in size (trillions of events a day), asperity, and the dynamic nature of an active adversary that adapts to our advances in the field.

This role is a chance to work in impactful outcomes that improve people's security and safety, while also growing in depth and breadth. From assemble, lifting, decompilation to optimal control and continuous optimization, every problem in the spectrum of computer science and related disciplines occurs in tackling the problems CrowdStrike deals with. An excellent candidate will have a intrinsic desire to learn and leverage tools across these domains, invent new tools to fill the gaps in what we need, and a desire to increase their leverage by enabling a team to perform these critical research objectives.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead and mentor a team of data scientists, providing technical guidance, career development, and performance management

  • Work with senior leadership to refine/define priorities, identify risks/gaps, support staff and budget planning, and disseminate key milestones to the business leaders.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including security research, engineering, and product to align ML capabilities with business objectives

  • Partner with security domain experts to identify high-impact opportunities where ML can enhance threat detection and response

  • Communicate complex technical concepts and ML insights to stakeholders across the organization

  • Guide the development of advanced models for malware detection, behavioral threat analysis, and AI-driven security automation

  • Drive research initiatives that result in publications, blog posts, patents, and other contributions to the ML and security communities

  • Contribute to hands-on technical work when needed, maintaining deep expertise in ML systems and security applications

What You’ll Need:

  • Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD) in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, or related STEM field, OR Bachelor’s degree with equivalent experience

  • 5+ years of experience in data science and machine learning

  • 5+ years in a technical leadership or team lead capacity

  • Proven track record of leading ML projects from research to production deployment

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

  • Ability to present and work with senior stakeholders in a business, communicate risks/opportunities, and translate business problems into technical objectives

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, and ability to keep track of multiple projects, and distill key details for regular program management.

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Bonus Points:

  • Deep expertise in cybersecurity, including experience in threat intelligence, malware analysis, or security operations

  • Experience with agentic AI systems, LLMs, or autonomous security automation

  • Track record of working with very large, sparse, high-dimensional datasets in production environments

  • Experience with advanced ML techniques including semi-supervised learning, online learning, and model optimization for reducing false positives

  • Strong knowledge of ML operations, including model monitoring, A/B testing, and production ML infrastructure

  • Comfortable working in cloud environments (AWS) and Linux systems

  • Proven ability to set technical vision and drive innovation in ML systems

  • Experience hiring, building, and scaling high-performing data science teams

  • Strategic mindset with ability to balance research exploration with pragmatic business outcomes

Additional Qualifications:

  • Published research, patents, or contributions to the ML or security communities

Role Summary

As a Research Assistant, you will go beyond basic data collection to actively support the design, execution, and communication of research that shapes how the world understands Muslim-friendly travel. Working alongside our Research, Data, and Intelligence team, you will help transform raw data into compelling, business-ready insights for governments, destinations, and corporate clients. In this role, AI is a force multiplier for rigorous research — accelerating literature reviews, supporting data synthesis, and streamlining report drafting. We expect strong human judgment, methodological integrity, and critical thinking to verify AI-generated outputs before they carry the CrescentRating standard. You will own this human-in-the-loop approach, applying modern tools to the analytical heavy lifting while your intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, and understanding of the Muslim travel landscape ensure every output meets our authoritative standard.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research Design & Execution:Design, develop, and disseminate appropriate quantitative surveys and conduct desk-based research to generate actionable insights for industry stakeholders.

  • Data Analysis & Reporting:Collect, collate, analyze, and translate quantitative results into intuitive, business-friendly reports using a variety of approaches and methodologies.

  • Report Production:Assist in the preparation of research reports and work closely with graphic designers to develop infographics and visually compelling deliverables.

  • Client Support:Serve as the first level of support and contact point for clients seeking information on research and consultancy products and services.

  • Business Development:Prepare proposals for research and consultancy products for prospective clients, and support efforts to establish and grow relationships within existing accounts.

  • AI-Augmented Research Workflows:Actively leverage AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity) to accelerate literature reviews, secondary research, and report drafting — while applying rigorous human oversight to verify accuracy and methodological soundness.

Where opportunities arise, explore and prototype lightweight AI-assisted tools (e.g., custom GPTs, prompt frameworks, or simple automation scripts) that streamline recurring research tasks and reduce manual processing time.

Working Details

  • Arrangement: Remote

  • Duration: 4 Months

  • Hours: Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM SGT (GMT+8)


Requirements

Must Have

  • Bachelor's degree in Social Sciences, Business, Economics, Statistics, or a related field — final-year students are welcome to apply

  • Strong command of written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate research findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Basic understanding of research methodologies and research management, including survey design and quantitative analysis

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets for data collection, organization, and analysis

  • Working knowledge of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity) for research assistance — including conducting literature reviews, synthesizing secondary data, and supporting report drafting — with the critical judgment to verify outputs and maintain methodological rigor

  • Good communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

Good to Have

  • Interest in the travel industry, particularly the Muslim-friendly travel segment, and an appreciation of the cultural nuances that shape this market

  • Familiarity with survey platforms (e.g., Google Forms, SurveyMonkey, Typeform) and quantitative research tools

  • Exposure to data visualization tools or basic infographic design for communicating research findings

  • Experience writing research summaries, academic papers, or business reports

  • Understanding of the halal economy, Muslim consumer behavior, or global travel and tourism trends

  • Experience building or configuring AI-assisted tools — such as custom GPTs, prompt libraries, or no-code automation workflows — to solve practical research or data-processing problems

Application requirement
Submit your brief CV through our career website or send it via email — format: PDF​

  • Remote working flexibility with a globally distributed team

  • Collaborative, diverse, and inclusive working environment

  • Meaningful real-world experience contributing to research that reaches governments, destinations, and global industry stakeholders

  • Strong focus on professional development and continuous learning

  • Opportunity to contribute to high-impact projects at the forefront of the Muslim travel economy, including the Global Muslim Travel Index (GMTI) and other flagship CrescentRating publications

Location, Reporting & Travel

This is a fully remote role within the United States. Periodic travel (approximately 25–30%) will be required to conduct in-person meetings with members, support conferences and member engagement events, and attend internal team gatherings.

Reports to: Senior Director, Member Success, Academic

About Us

E3n is a not-for-profit, member-based organization serving independent schools, educators, students, and families across the full student lifecycle.

Formed through the merger of the former Educational Records Bureau (ERB) and the Enrollment Management Association (EMA), E3n builds on nearly a century of collective expertise in assessment, enrollment, and student development. E3n exists to deepen school impact and advance whole-student growth by uniting academic and enrollment leadership around shared, data-driven insights.

E3n provides comprehensive assessments, professional tools, conferences, and analytics that help independent schools demonstrate their value and support student success from pre-enrollment through graduation—extending beyond academic performance to include student well-being, sense of belonging, and social-emotional development.

About the Opportunity

The Director, Member Success, Academic, plays a key role in supporting E3n member schools and organizations in effectively using the organization's achievement assessments, student well-being tools, data resources, and professional learning offerings.

Working closely with the Senior Director, Member Success (Academic), this role manages relationships with a portfolio of member schools and helps ensure members experience meaningful value from their engagement with E3n. The Director serves as a trusted partner to academic leaders, providing guidance, support, and resources that help schools understand and apply assessment and student well-being data to strengthen teaching, learning, and student outcomes.

The Director collaborates with colleagues across the organization to ensure members receive timely support, successful onboarding experiences, and access to the resources they need to maximize the value of E3n's academic and student well-being tools and services. The role also plays an important part in identifying emerging member needs and sharing insights internally to strengthen E3n's products, services, and overall member experience.

The ideal candidate brings strong relationship management and consultative communication skills and is comfortable partnering directly with heads of school, academic deans, curriculum and instructional leaders, counselors, and other school-based educators. They are confident presenting to professional audiences, facilitating thoughtful conversations around assessment data and instructional improvement, and managing multiple member relationships in a dynamic environment. The successful candidate is motivated by helping schools translate data into meaningful action while serving as a trusted partner who brings member insights back to E3n to inform future products, services, and strategy.

What You’ll Do

Reporting to the Senior Director, Member Success (Academic), the Director is responsible for managing member relationships and supporting the success of schools within their assigned portfolio.

Member Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary relationship manager for a portfolio of member schools.
  • Build and maintain trusted partnerships with heads of school, academic deans, curriculum leaders, division directors, counselors, and instructional leadership teams.
  • Act as a strategic partner, helping schools maximize the value of E3n's products and services.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each member's goals, priorities, and challenges while identifying opportunities to strengthen engagement and long-term partnership.

Member Onboarding & Engagement

  • Support onboarding of new members to ensure successful implementation of E3n's achievement assessments and related products and services..
  • Guide schools through effective use of assessment and student well-being tools, reporting platforms, and professional learning opportunities.
  • Facilitate ongoing engagement through regular member conversations focused on adoption, utilization, and member success.
  • Support opportunities to expand member engagement, including Associate-to-Full membership growth and additional product utilization as appropriate.

Member Support & Consultation

  • Partner with internal teams to respond to member questions and support requests in a timely manner.
  • Help schools interpret assessment results and connect insights to instructional planning and student success.
  • Coordinate with Product, Research, Professional Learning, and Platform teams to resolve member questions and improve the overall experience.
  • Ensure members receive practical guidance and resources that help them confidently leverage E3n's products and services.

Member Experience & Portfolio Insights

  • Monitor engagement across an assigned portfolio and identify opportunities to strengthen member success and retention.
  • Gather feedback from member schools and share insights to improve E3n's products, services, and member experience.
  • Identify emerging trends, challenges, and opportunities across member schools and communicate those insights internally.
  • Maintain accurate records and timely Salesforce records by documenting member interactions, engagement, opportunities, and support activities.
  • Monitor product utilization and proactively identify opportunities to deepen engagement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with colleagues across Membership, Product, Research, Professional Learning, Growth, and Platform teams to deliver an exceptional member experience.
  • Contribute member insights that inform future products, services, research, and programming.
  • Support broader Member Success initiatives and organizational priorities.
  • Identify opportunities for product expansion or additional member engagement and collaborate with appropriate internal partners to support growth.

Member Engagement Activities

  • Represent E3n through conferences, webinars, workshops, and member-facing events.
  • Facilitate professional learning opportunities and discussions focused on assessment, instructional improvement, and student success.
  • Build relationships with prospective and existing member schools while representing the organization's mission and expertise.

Why Work with Us

At E3n, you’ll join a mission-driven organization formed through the unification of two respected leaders in independent education. We’re building something new—bringing together enrollment and academic perspectives to create deeper insight, stronger institutions, and better outcomes for students from pre-enrollment through graduation.

At E3n, you’ll experience:

  • Purpose with impact. Our work directly supports educators, school leaders, and families nationwide. The decisions we make—and the tools we build—matter.
  • Smart, thoughtful colleagues. You’ll work alongside people who care deeply about education, ask good questions, and value collaboration, clarity, and integrity.
  • Whole-person thinking. Just as we help schools understand the full student journey, we strive to support employees as whole people—recognizing that strong work is sustained by balance, trust, and belonging.
  • Growth during a moment of transformation. E3n is actively evolving. That means opportunities to shape systems, influence direction, and grow alongside an organization defining its future.
  • Values-driven, data-informed. We balance heart and rigor—grounding our work in evidence while staying anchored in empathy, equity, and real-world impact.

If you’re energized by meaningful work, thoughtful problem-solving, and helping schools better serve students, you’ll find a home at E3n.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 9-12+ years of experience in education, academic leadership, assessment, member success, customer success, or relationship management.
  • Experience working with schools, educators, or education-focused organizations.

Preferred Skills & Experiences

  • Experience working within independent or private schools.
  • Experience supporting educators through assessment programs, educational data systems, or instructional improvement initiatives.
  • Background in teaching, curriculum development and planning, academic leadership, or educational assessment.
  • Experience presenting to professional audiences or facilitating workshops for educators and school leaders.
  • Experience in independent school admissions or enrollment management is a plus, particularly for candidates who also bring strong academic, teaching, or instructional leadership experience.

E3n is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming workplace. We believe our work is stronger when people of different backgrounds, identities, and experiences come together.

Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.

Job Summary

The Sr. Technical Security Analyst is responsible for ensuring the organization's physical security technical infrastructure and systems are secure from potential risks and vulnerabilities. This role involves conducting physical security technical assessments, deploying security technologies, troubleshooting technical issues, and providing guidance to staff and end-users on security-related matters. The Sr. Analyst will also collaborate with cross-functional teams, assist in the development of security policies, and ensure compliance with regulations and industry best practices.

Job Description

Responsibilities:

  • Utilizes technical expertise and industry best practices to implement physical security technology solutions that address the organization's unique security requirements.
  • Configures and maintains physical security software, applications, and other physical security tools, to protect the organization's assets.
  • Provides input on the architecture and engineering of new and existing physical security applications, including evaluating technical designs.
  • Develops detailed plans for implementing selected physical security solutions, including hardware, software, configuration parameters, and test plans.
  • Troubleshoots physical security applications and server issues, ensuring timely resolution.
  • Supports the integration of infrastructure with physical security solutions, ensuring requirements are met.
  • Resolves security incidents promptly, troubleshoots technical issues, and determines root causes.
  • Provides technical guidance and support to other staff and end-users on physical security-related matters.
  • Supports physical security device inventory, lifecycle management, and configuration standards.
  • Assists in facilitating the Physical Security Break/Fix Program, tracking issues and status, prioritizing urgent issues, and documenting related processes.
  • Supports management with physical security system administration projects and initiatives from inception to completion.
  • Collaborates with Legal, Compliance teams and Cyber/IT, as needed, and coordinates the physical security technology component of internal and external audits to ensure physical security programs adhere to relevant laws, regulations, standards, and policies.
  • Evaluates new physical security threats, technology trends, and develop effective physical security technical controls.
  • Stays updated on industry and regulatory trends to maintain current knowledge.
  • Compiles reports, dashboards, or operational metrics to measure the effectiveness of the technical security program.
  • Communicates complex security concepts to non-technical stakeholders and provides clear and concise reports.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience administering enterprise physical security platforms such as Genetec Security Center, Honeywell Pro-Watch, AMAG Symmetry, LenelS2 OnGuard, WinPak, or similar systems
  • Experience administering enterprise video management systems (VMS) such as Genetec, Milestone, Avigilon, or similar
  • Experience managing physical security hardware platforms including Mercury controllers, AMAG, Axis, Hanwha, Bosch, HID, DMP, or similar
  • Experience administering large-scale deployments of access control, video surveillance, and intrusion detection systems
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, SDKs, or integration frameworks
  • Experience with Python, C++, or similar programming languages
  • Knowledge of access control credential technologies, including Wiegand and OSDP, credential bit formats, mobile credentials, and encrypted card technologies such as SEOS (Elite) and DESFire
  • Experience with Microsoft SQL queries and database structures.
  • Experience with video analytics platforms such as KiwiVision, BriefCam, Avigilon Appearance Search, or similar
  • Thorough knowledge of networking concepts including IPv4 / IPv6, subnetting, DHCP, DNS and network segmentation
  • Practical experience working in and supporting enterprise Windows Server environments
  • Experience troubleshooting system outages, device failures, and software/application issues
  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale deployments of physical security infrastructure
  • Strong documentation skills including system architecture diagrams, troubleshooting guides, and operational procedures
  • Familiarity with camera analytics tuning and event detection configuration
  • Experience integrating physical security systems with Azure AD / Entra

Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred in an area of study relevant to this position (i.e., Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Information Systems Management, Business Administration, Risk Management, etc.)

  • Generally, requires four plus years of related experience.

Working Conditions:

  • Must participate on an on-call schedule and be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s), and overtime, as necessary.

Employees at all levels are expected to:

  • Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
  • Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
  • Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.

raw.title: KI-Dozent:in in Teilzeit (20h) (m/w/d) | 100% remote
raw.excerpt: Viele Menschen fragen sich aktuell: "Welche Aufgaben übernehme ich morgen noch - und was brauche ich, um in Zukunft relevant zu bleiben?
raw.description:
Viele Menschen fragen sich aktuell: "Welche Aufgaben übernehme ich morgen noch - und was brauche ich, um in Zukunft relevant zu bleiben?"

Das Institut für Zukunftsbildung (IZB) hat eine klare Antwort: Wir qualifizieren Menschen so, dass sie nicht von KI-Entwicklungen überrollt werden, sondern die Zukunft aktiv gestalten. Mit unserem zertifizierten Programm „KI Leader“ schaffen wir Orientierung, vermitteln praxisnahe Kompetenzen und eröffnen neue Perspektiven für die Arbeitswelt von morgen. Unser Leitsatz: Wenn Maschinen lernen, müssen Menschen wachsen.

Für einen festen Kurs suchen wir eine KI-Dozent:in in Teilzeit (20 Stunden/Woche, 100 % remote) – im Tandem mit einer Hauptdozentin oder einem Hauptdozenten.

Das gibt es konkret

  • 20 Stunden pro Woche, komplett remote
  • Start so schnell wie möglich – wir richten uns nach deiner Verfügbarkeit
  • Du läufst im Tandem mit einem Hauptdozenten in einem festen Kurs
  • Dein Schwerpunkt sind die Tutorien, inklusive 1:1-Zeit mit einzelnen Teilnehmenden
  • Dazu kommt das Einspringen, wenn in einem der Kurse jemand krank wird oder Urlaub hat

Warum Tandem und nicht allein?

Weil die meisten Weiterbildungen nicht am Stoff scheitern. Sie scheitern daran, dass niemand merkt, wenn jemand bei Modul 3 abgehängt wird und sich drei Wochen lang nicht traut, das zu sagen. Feste Tandems sind bei uns dafür da, dass die Teilnehmenden sich aufgehoben fühlen und über die vier Monate immer dieselben zwei Menschen vor sich haben – denen sie dann auch menschlich vertrauen.

Und: Ein Tandem soll ergänzen, nicht verdoppeln. Unser Hauptdozent wünscht sich ausdrücklich jemanden, der Change Management und Business Consulting tiefer mitdenkt als er selbst – also die Person, die in der 1:1-Zeit nicht nur die Prompt-Frage beantwortet, sondern mit der Teilnehmerin durchdenkt, wie der Rollout im eigenen Unternehmen an den Menschen scheitern könnte und was das für ihren KI-Fahrplan heißt.

So sieht die Woche im Kurs in der Regel aus

  • Mo Tutorium 09:30–17:00
  • Di Workshop 09:30–15:30
  • Mi Tutorium 13:15–17:15
  • Do Tutorium 09:30–12:45
  • Fr Feedback-Runde 09:00–10:30

Wer davon was übernimmt, sprichst du direkt mit dem Hauptdozenten ab. Wir geben da nichts vor. Uns ist nur wichtig, dass bei Ausfällen Flexibilität von deiner Seite möglich ist, damit der Lehrbetrieb normal weiterlaufen kann.

Aufgaben

  • Tutorien durchführen: Du begleitest die Teilnehmenden durch Übungs- und Vertiefungszeiten – nah dran, praxisnah, mit Raum für Fragen
  • Workflows mitbauen: Du sitzt mit den Teilnehmenden konkret an ihren eigenen Use Cases und hilfst beim Bauen – Automatisierungen, GPTs/Agents, Prompt-Ketten, Anbindungen an bestehende Tools. Nicht nur erklären, sondern mitbauen
  • 1:1-Begleitung: Du merkst früh, wenn jemand hängt, und gehst aktiv auf die Person zu, statt zu warten, bis sie sich meldet
  • Change- und Beratungsperspektive einbringen: Du hilfst den Teilnehmenden, ihre KI-Vorhaben organisational zu denken – Stakeholder, Widerstände, Prozesse, Business Case
  • Vermittlung der Lerninhalte: Inhalte, Ablaufplan und didaktische Konzepte sind von uns entwickelt und werden von dir umgesetzt
  • Vertretung & Einspringen: Bei Krankheit oder Urlaub übernimmst du kurzfristig Einheiten in anderen Kursen
  • Abstimmung im Tandem: Rollenverteilung, Übergaben und Teilnehmenden-Themen klärst du direkt mit deinem Tandempartner
  • Organisatorische Verlässlichkeit: Dokumentation, Lernzielkontrollen, Anwesenheitslisten

Qualifikation

  • Begeisterung für Menschen & Wissensvermittlung: Du hast Spaß an der Arbeit mit Erwachsenen und schaffst eine motivierende Lernatmosphäre – idealerweise mit Erfahrung in virtuellen Gruppen
  • Praxiserprobte KI-Kompetenz mit Bau-Erfahrung: Du hast selbst schon KI-Workflows gebaut – mit Sprachmodellen, Automatisierungs-Tools (z. B. n8n, Make, Zapier), APIs oder Custom GPTs/Agents. Du kannst dich neben eine Teilnehmerin setzen und ihren Workflow gemeinsam zum Laufen bringen
  • Change Management & Business Consulting: Erfahrung aus Beratung, Transformations- oder Organisationsprojekten ist ausdrücklich erwünscht – das ist die Ergänzung, die sich unser Hauptdozent im Tandem wünscht
  • Gespür für Lernende: Du erkennst, wenn jemand still abhängt, und sprichst es an – Nähe zur Gruppe ist bei uns kein Nice-to-have, sondern der Kern der Rolle
  • Ganzheitliche KI-Transformation: Bei uns lernen Menschen, mehrdimensionale KI-Fahrpläne für ihre Organisation zu entwickeln – dein Herz schlägt für Partizipation und durchdachte Change-Prozesse
  • Flexibilität: Du kannst bei Ausfällen kurzfristig einspringen und dich auf wechselnde Kurse einstellen
  • Verlässliche Persönlichkeit: Strukturiert, verantwortungsbewusst und kommunikationsstark
  • Standort: Wohnsitz in Deutschland

Du erfüllst noch nicht alle Punkte? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Uns interessiert nicht nur der Blick in deine Vergangenheit – sondern wohin du willst. Überzeug uns mit deiner Haltung, deiner KI-Neugier und deiner Lust, Menschen wirksam durch den Wandel zu begleiten.

Benefits

  • Sinnstiftende Mission: Du wirkst bei einem Bildungsträger mit klarer Vision mit – wir befähigen Menschen, KI-Transformation in ihren Organisationen zu gestalten
  • 100 % Remote & Teilzeit: 20 Stunden pro Woche, von wo du willst – mit Vertrauen und Eigenverantwortung
  • Echtes Tandem statt Einzelkämpfertum: Du stehst nie allein vor der Gruppe und hast eine feste Person an deiner Seite
  • Lernen von den Besten: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenem Gründer und Programmleitung, dazu unser Expert:innen-Netzwerk aus Recht, Technik und Organisationsentwicklung
  • Echte Entwicklungsperspektive: Eigene Schwerpunkte ausbauen ist ausdrücklich erwünscht #growthmindset
  • Werteorientiertes Umfeld: Zukunftsorientierung, Menschlichkeit und Neugier gehen bei uns Hand in Hand

Vielfalt im Team

Wir legen großen Wert auf ein diverses Team – unterschiedliche Perspektiven vor der Gruppe machen unsere Kurse spürbar besser. Frauen sind in unserem Dozent:innen-Team aktuell unterrepräsentiert; über Bewerbungen von Frauen freuen wir uns daher besonders. Ausgeschrieben ist die Stelle selbstverständlich für alle Geschlechter (m/w/d) – entschieden wird nach Eignung.

Wenn du Freude daran hast, Menschen durch den Wandel der Arbeitswelt zu begleiten und KI greifbar zu machen – dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Bitte sende uns:

  • Deinen Lebenslauf
  • Ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben (max. 1 Seite) – warum passt du zu uns? Kurzvideos sind ein Plus
  • Optional: Dein Persönlichkeitsprofil von 16Personalities – hilft uns, dich besser kennenzulernen.

Meet the Team

Join a dynamic AI-Native Engineering Team at Cisco, where we are redefining enterprise software development through modern AI-driven tools and rapid innovation. Our team’s purpose is to design, build, and scale internal platforms that streamline operations, reduce third-party software costs, and accelerate Cisco’s digital transformation. You’ll collaborate with a highly skilled, matrixed group of developers, technical experts, and multi-functional partners from operations, product, and strategy. The team thrives in an agile, collaborative environment that values bias to action, continuous learning, and the opportunity to influence core business outcomes. If you’re excited about being on the forefront of AI-enabled engineering at scale, this is the place for you.

You will lead the adoption of AI-native best practices, mentor engineers, and collaborate with partners to ensure solutions align with Cisco’s strategic objectives.

  • Architect, develop, and scale AI-enabled platforms that replace legacy enterprise tools and drive operational efficiencies

  • Lead and mentor engineers, embedding AI-assisted development practices to elevate code quality and delivery velocity

  • Collaborate with multi-functional teams to align technical solutions with business and operational goals

  • Evaluate and integrate emerging AI tools, frameworks, and best practices into the engineering workflow

  • Ensure the team’s outputs achieve tangible business outcomes, including cost savings and improved productivity

Minimum Qualifications

  • 12+ years of relevant technical experience with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

  • Experience building and delivering enterprise software solutions

  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) integrated into production workflows

  • Experience designing, developing, and maintaining engineering harnesses (e.g., test automation frameworks, CI/CD infrastructure)

raw.description:
At EverCommerce [Nasdaq: EVCM], we are on a mission to digitally transform the service economy with tailored, end-to-end SaaS solutions that simplify and empower the lives of our 725,000+ customers. As a leading service commerce platform, our modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals in the areas of Home & Field Services, Health Services, and Wellness industries.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here:

We are seeking a customer-focused, detail-oriented Account Support Specialist to join our Account Support team. This role serves as a key point of contact for customers with non-technical account and operational needs, including billing inquiries, contract and plan questions, account updates, training coordination, administrative requests, and other account-related support.

The Account Support Specialist is responsible for owning customer requests from initial contact through resolution, providing timely, accurate, and empathetic support across multiple channels. This individual will work closely with Customer Success, Onboarding & Implementation, Technical Support, Finance, Sales, and Operations to resolve customer needs, coordinate cross-functional requests, and reduce friction throughout the customer journey.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving problems, navigating operational processes, working across teams, and creating positive customer experiences in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities:

Customer & Account Support

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for non-technical customer inquiries across email, ticketing systems, phone, chat, and other support channels.
  • Assist customers with billing questions, account updates, contract and plan inquiries, training coordination, and administrative requests.
  • Own assigned customer cases from intake through resolution, ensuring timely follow-up and clear communication throughout the process.
  • Research customer questions and provide accurate, complete, and easy-to-understand responses.
  • Demonstrate empathy, professionalism, and sound judgment in every customer interaction.
  • Identify the appropriate path for requests requiring assistance from another team and ensure effective handoffs.
  • Help reduce repeat contacts by addressing the customer's full need whenever possible.

Case Management & Operational Excellence

  • Manage an assigned queue of customer requests while meeting established service-level agreements (SLAs), response time expectations, and productivity goals.
  • Accurately document customer interactions, actions taken, and resolutions within CRM and support systems.
  • Follow established workflows, standard operating procedures (SOPs), escalation paths, and quality standards.
  • Prioritize requests based on urgency, customer impact, and established business processes.
  • Identify recurring customer issues, process gaps, and sources of friction and share insights with Account Support leadership.
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of internal processes, documentation, playbooks, and workflows.
  • Maintain strong attention to detail when completing account changes, billing-related requests, and other administrative activities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Customer Success, Onboarding & Implementation, Finance/Billing, Sales & Account Management, Technical Support, and Operations to resolve customer requests.
  • Coordinate customer needs that require action or information from multiple internal teams.
  • Follow established ownership and handoff processes to ensure requests reach the appropriate team without unnecessary delays or escalations.
  • Provide clear and complete context when escalating or transferring customer requests.
  • Participate in operational readiness efforts for process changes, launches, and other initiatives impacting Account Support.

Customer Experience & Quality

  • Deliver accurate, professional, and empathetic support experiences that build customer trust.
  • Consistently meet established case quality and documentation standards.
  • Take ownership of customer issues and proactively communicate status and next steps when immediate resolution is not possible.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the customer experience and reduce effort for common account-related needs.
  • Support customer adoption of available self-service resources when appropriate.
  • Incorporate coaching and quality feedback to continuously improve individual performance.

AI, Knowledge & Continuous Improvement

  • Effectively use approved AI-assisted support tools, knowledge resources, and automation to improve the speed and quality of customer support.
  • Provide feedback when knowledge content, automated workflows, or internal resources are incomplete or inaccurate.
  • Identify repetitive requests or manual processes that may be candidates for automation or process improvement.
  • Contribute to accurate, reusable knowledge by documenting new processes, common customer questions, and effective resolutions.
  • Adapt to evolving tools, processes, policies, and customer support models.

Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:

  • 2+ years of experience in Customer Support, Customer Operations, Account Services, Billing Operations, or a related customer-facing environment.
  • Experience managing customer inquiries or cases in a high-volume environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain information clearly and professionally.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently research and resolve customer questions.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple internal teams to resolve customer needs.
  • Experience working within CRM, ticketing, or customer support platforms.
  • Customer-focused with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Empathetic and professional when navigating challenging customer situations.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Analytical and solutions-oriented approach to problem solving.
  • Ability to effectively prioritize work in a high-volume environment.
  • Comfortable working with performance metrics, service-level expectations, and quality standards.
  • Collaborative and effective at working across teams and functions.
  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a rapidly evolving environment.
  • Process-oriented with a continuous improvement mindset.
  • Curious and willing to learn new tools, systems, products, and processes.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in healthcare technology, SaaS, or another highly regulated customer environment.
  • Experience supporting billing, contract, subscription, plan, or account-related customer inquiries.
  • Experience with platforms such as Salesforce (SFDC), Zendesk, Intercom, Jira, or knowledge management systems.
  • Experience using AI-assisted support platforms, automation tools, or AI-enabled workflows.
  • Familiarity with customer lifecycle operations, including onboarding, ongoing account support, and retention.

Where: Remote within the US

The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States– if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.

Benefits and Perks

  • Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid
  • Continued investment in your professional development
  • Day 1 access to a robust health and wellness benefits package, including an annual wellness stipend.
  • 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting
  • Flexible and generous (FTO) time-off
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program

The target total compensation for this position is $18 to $20 USD per hour in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!

A Pmweb está procurando uma pessoa assim, com paixão por resolução de problemas complexos, que ame tecnologia e que esteja buscando por novos desafios. Você será responsável por manter e evoluir nossa plataforma tecnológica na nuvem, focando em disponibilizar recursos que acelerem o processo de desenvolvimento e garantindo a continuidade dos nossos serviços.

Se você se identificou, venha nos ajudar a construir e a manter a nossa infraestrutura de tecnologia funcionando com altos níveis de SLA/SLO.

  • Implantar e administrar recursos na nuvem como servidores, redes, firewalls, bancos de dados e balanceadores de carga;
  • Desenvolver e implementar arquiteturas com foco na segurança, estabilidade, escalabilidade e confiabilidade;
  • Apoiar as equipes de desenvolvimento e de segurança com a definição da infraestrutura;
  • Monitorar os ambientes e prestar suporte operacional;
  • Participar do on-call rotation (plantões 18x7);
  • Manter a documentação da equipe atualizada;
  • Automatizar as atividades de infraestrutura e suporte;
  • Programar infraestrutura como serviço mantendo o código protegido, atualizado e documentado;
  • Atuar em conjunto com os desenvolvedores durante o ciclo de deploy de aplicações e em salas de crise;
  • Fornecer feedback, insights de métricas e análise de dados para as equipes de desenvolvimento;
  • Automatizar pipelines de integração contínua (CI) e entrega contínua (CD);
  • Gerar relatórios de métricas de desempenho, disponibilidade e confiabilidade dos serviços.
  • Experiência prática com nuvens públicas, como AWS e/ou GCP;
  • Experiência com contêiner engines, como Docker, containerd e/ou Podman;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de IaC e GitOps, como Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, AWS CDK, Ansible, Chef e/ou Puppet;
  • Experiência com pipelines de integração contínua (CI) e entrega contínua (CD), utilizando ferramentas como GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, CircleCI e/ou GitHub Actions;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em administração e troubleshooting de sistemas operacionais Linux e/ou Windows;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em scripting languages, principalmente Bash e PowerShell;
  • Bons conhecimentos em plataformas de observabilidade e monitoramento, como Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana, Fluentd e/ou Elastic Search;
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura de micro-serviços e sistemas distribuídos;
  • Conhecimentos em administração e troubleshooting de webservers, como NGINX, Apache e/ou IIS;
  • Conhecimentos em protocolos de rede, como TCP e HTTP;
  • Mentalidade voltada para automação e melhoria contínua (mindset de "automatizar tudo!").

Informações adicionais

Será um diferencial se você:

  • Tiver conhecimentos em gerir, monitorar e administrar serviços de orquestração de containers como GKE, AWS EKS ou AWS ECS;
  • Tiver vivência em ambientes que adotam a cultura e práticas DevOps;
  • Tiver proficiência em ao menos uma linguagem de programação como Python, Ruby ou Go;
  • Tiver conhecimentos avançados em bancos de dados relacionais, como MySQL, PostgreSQL e/ou SQL Server.

Was du mitbringst:

Wir gestalten eine respektvolle, diverse und inklusive Arbeitsumgebung, indem wir die individuellen Bedürfnisse, Perspektiven und Potenziale aller anerkennen.
